elevator_pitch: A precision analog front-end PCB built around the TLV2372 dual op-amp IC, implementing a non-inverting gain stage for sensor signal conditioning with selectable gain resistors and BNC I/O.
description:
• TLV2372 rail-to-rail op-amp with gains selectable by variable resistor — covers the full sensor-band amplification range from a single 5 V supply.

• Star-ground topology with analog/digital split and 100 nF ceramic decoupler keeps noise below the op-amp's thermal floor.

• Both channels break out independently on BNC connectors for direct scope or data-acquisition use.
